Board title: November 2024 AI Industry Rankings | APP Boards
Publisher: Unique Research · Date: December 22, 2024
Sources: diversified hybrid · Compiled by: Unique Research
Window: November 1–30, 2024

Board set — Global AI APP

  • Downloads TOP100 · Download growth TOP100
  • MAU TOP100 · MAU growth TOP100
  • Time-spent TOP100 · Time-spent growth TOP100
  • Stickiness (per-user time) TOP100
  • Bestsellers (IAP revenue, excl. ads / direct pay / third-party Android) TOP100 · Bestseller growth TOP100

Board set — China domestic AI APP

  • Downloads / download growth TOP50
  • MAU / MAU growth TOP50
  • Time-spent / time-spent growth TOP50

Board set — China-outbound AI APP

  • Downloads / download growth TOP30
  • MAU / MAU growth TOP30
  • Time-spent / time-spent growth TOP30

[All ranked tables in CN charts — attach images.json on import]

01. Global AI APP boards

Methodology: Unique Research independent tracking of thousands of AI companies and ~10k products. Rank by monthly cumulative downloads; MoM download change; active users; MoM MAU change; usage duration; MoM duration change; per-user duration (stickiness); IAP revenue (excl. ads, direct pay, third-party Android); MoM IAP change.

02. China domestic AI APP boards

Same metrics for Chinese founders targeting the China market — Top 50 each for downloads, download growth, MAU, MAU growth, time, time growth.

03. Outbound AI APP boards

Chinese / ethnic-Chinese founders targeting overseas markets — Top 30 each for downloads, download growth, MAU, MAU growth, time, time growth.

04. Research notes

Hybrid sources + Unique Research algorithms. Scope and exclusions match other ranking packages (WEB/APP only; >10k monthly visits universe). Geography: overseas / domestic / outbound. Function: AI-native / AI-feature / AI-ecosystem. Metric definitions: visits, UV, duration; downloads, sessions, active users, duration time.
